result.summary: Analyzed the page and found a major content layout issue with the Trattoria Piccolo restaurant card, where key text is partially clipped, making content unreadable. No other significant visual breaks detected beyond the allowed carousel partial visibility cases.

issues.description: The Trattoria Piccolo restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section has its full name and delivery fee details partially clipped by the right edge of the viewport, leaving critical content unreadable (the name is cut mid-word and the full delivery fee is obscured).
issues.suggestion: Adjust the card layout to allow full visibility of the restaurant name and fee: either reduce the card width to fit within the viewport (while retaining horizontal scrolling for the carousel), or truncate the text with an ellipsis to ensure no partial clipping of critical content that breaks readability.
